content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.iitr.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Technology, Polymer Science, Polymer Engineering, or an equivalent field. A minimum of 2 SCI journal publications is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any preference for specific knowledge in the selection of Research Associates?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with well-versed knowledge of inorganic and zeolite synthesis are preferred for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 58,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the Research Associate recruitment at IIT Roorkee. This applies to all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate position announced by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIT Roorkee. Direct links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the Research Associate position at IIT Roorkee is a contractual job. The terms and duration of the contract will be as per the institute's policy and the official notification.
